title: How to Build a Waitlist Landing Page with AI (And Grow It From 0 to 1,000)
summary: The best waitlists have a clear promise, a way to skip the line, and a count that moves. Build a viral referral waitlist with Blink — email capture, position tracking, and referral links — in under an hour.
body_markdown: Add email verification: send a confirmation link that must be clicked before the position is assigned. Unverified signups don't get a position number and don't appear in the admin count. Prompt Blink: "Add email verification. Members only receive their position after clicking the link in their confirmation email."
